messages:
anya: heads-up: publish CI failed for @redwood/sampleapp. release-stamp blocked due to regen-driven type change. failing check: changelog mismatch. CI log: https://ci.redwood/example/2467
ci-bot: Build #2467 failed: release-stamp checks  changelog-check returned 1. See artifacts for diff. :warning:
jack: quick summary of the diff? prefer a small excerpt rather than whole file pls
anya: short: generated types swapped parameter order on session.create and a few helpers. positional callers could break. old: `createSession(userId: string, opts?: CreateOpts)` new: `createSession(opts?: CreateOpts, userId?: string)`
rachel: that looks like the preserveParameterOrder flag got reset during the codegen config cleanup PR (#7890). I commented on that PR yesterday but didn't realize it would hit regen straight away.
sam: policy question: do we treat param-order-only changes as breaking? TS positional calls yes, but many users use named params. release-stamp is conservative and correct by semver rules.
jack: plan: I can push a hotfix to typegen that restores legacy ordering. will run `yarn workspace @redwood/sampleapp typegen:regen` and open a PR with the exact before/after snippet.
anya: alternative is to add a changelog entry and bump minor (1.5.2 -> 1.6.0). that's faster if we need the release cut now. but we need explicit changelog entry to satisfy release-stamp.
ci-bot: tip: run `./scripts/release-stamp --check-changelog` locally to see what the CI expects. also `nvm use 18 && yarn` if you see typegen nondeterminism across platforms.
rachel: FYI the auth/retry tests in codegen-suite flaked on my local regen (node 20). could be a nondeterministic ordering in templates. filing an issue: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/4572
sam: build-team: can we make release-stamp show the exact hunks it expects in the changelog? right now the failure says mismatch but doesn't show the needed message. small DX win.
jack: ok opening PR with (A) local regen preserving legacy param order, (B) changelog note in CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased in case we need to accept change, and (C) CI checklist in PR description. will ping when ready.
anya: I'll hold the release until CI passes. If jack's fix lands today I'll proceed with the stamp. otherwise we'll merge the changelog-bump route and ship.
ci-bot: Suggestion: if you see flaky regen diffs, try deleting node_modules and running `yarn cache clean && yarn`. This has helped in a few cases.
rachel: adding a short blurb to the devex docs about codegen config hygiene. maybe add a unit test to ensure preserveParameterOrder remains stable.
anya: appreciated. small action items: jack -> PR, rachel -> test/issue, sam -> follow up with build-team on changelog verbosity. will update thread with outcome. :thumbsup:
